Host-aware BEAM and OTP control plane for Omarchy Quattro. Observes every local and distributed BEAM VM, manages host scheduler budgets and density, detects process pathologies and mailbox backpressure, visualizes supervision and cluster topology, and provides reversible runtime controls with zero application instrumentation required.

This repository contains aggressive system tweaks for Windows 10 that can significantly alter system behavior, remove built-in apps, disable security features, and change privacy-related settings. Use at your own risk. Test in a VM and create a full system image backup before running. Some changes may not be reversible.

A lightweight I/O scheduler and Virtual Memory (VM) optimizer for KernelSU. Modifies only the essentials—allowing UFS storage and the chipset to run cleanly without aggressive background processing overhead. Safe, reversible, and easy to install.

Axio is an imperative, high-level, and strongly typed programming language featuring a register-based VM that combines **Native Finite State Machines (FSM)** with **Deterministic Replay / Rollback execution**, providing first-class primitives for building reliable, event-driven, and reversible stateful applications.
